title: feat(iso16): B16 t=8 and t=14 type counts match B12: 7/5 and 26/15
science: Stability control on the isochrone structure: the t=8 and t=14 G+ type/radius counts on B_16(0) are IDENTICAL to the B_12(0) values (7 types/5 radii and 26 types/15 radii), with the same 33 representatives, so those two shells are fully interior and host-independent -- unlike the axis arrivals, which do move with the ball (t(12,0,0) 20->18, t(8,0,0) 16->14). Useful for separating genuine structure from boundary artifacts, but the type lists themselves duplicate #6752.
verdict_pair: reverse=absent face=absent (reports t8 7/5 and t14 26/15, matching B_12)
